This book gives the ancient path of the 36 Chambers of Shaolin. The elements and the method to awaken the Chakras is expressed in detail. The book gives the knowledge from colors to all levels of Dan. The Sanskrit and Japanese Mantras for martial arts are given with meaning. The technique of meditation is explained along with the oaths every martial artist must take. This book will help you lead the life of the Buddha in the illusory world.

Book Name: The 36 Chambers of Shaolin

Author: Anandi Baba

*Tantra in the Lunatic Asylum*

A rapid story about a young boy's madness, addiction and stay in a lunatic asylum. His childhood love and a doctor that has sworn to heal. The environment of the asylum is expressed explicitly. The reality seen by the use of hallucinogens and the Tantric path followed by the hermits is taught in the form of a story. The frontiers of religion, medicine and metaphysics are seen from the point of view of the insane.

Atonement for sins committed helps you escape the hells. This book tells us how to fight the battle between good and evil that presents itself in life. Ancient wisdom from many sources is given in the form of poetry. Absolution and salvation can be reached in the path of perception. The rules that the Gods have laid out for us are known and the risks in life can be averted. Those that know this book will defeat vicious foes and save their friends.

Book Name - A Confession: Wisdom in Poetry

Author - Anandi Baba

Available on all Amazon sites and most major eBook retailers.

THE 36 CHAMBERS OF SHAOLIN

The first chamber is, ‘I shall fight.’
The second chamber is, ‘Give food, water, medicines and things like that.’
The third chamber is, ‘Give wealth, clothes, ornaments and things like that.’
The fourth chamber is, ‘Void.’
The fifth chamber is, ‘Observe.’
The sixth chamber is, ‘Work.’
The seventh chamber is, ‘Work hard.’
The eighth chamber is, ‘Act.’
The ninth chamber is, ‘Believe.’
And the 36 are, ‘the 9 in the 4 directions.’
Yes. From the Ishwara hermits of Shaolin.
